help.title: Help
help.aboutBody: AI UI Gallery is a showcase of web UIs you can build by asking an AI assistant. Every exhibit is a working demo with its common name, an explanation, and an example prompt. Use it to find inspiration and to learn the vocabulary that makes AI requests precise.
howToUseItems: Open Gallery and browse by category, or type a keyword in the search box.
Tap a card to see the live demo, an explanation, and the prompt.
Press Copy on the Prompt tab and paste it into your AI assistant.
On the Prompt tab, pick your tech stack and extra requirements to tailor the prompt before copying it.
Use the Clear button to reset the search and category filter.
promptTipsItems: Name the UI pattern (e.g. "toast notification", "bento grid").
State your tech stack: plain HTML/CSS/JS, React, Vue, Tailwind CSS…
Describe behavior: states, animations, keyboard and touch support.
Mention accessibility and dark mode if you need them.
Iterate: ask for small changes one at a time after the first result.
help.technologyBody: Built with React, TypeScript and Vite, styled with Tailwind CSS, and published on GitHub Pages. Search runs in a Web Worker so typing stays smooth, demos are loaded on demand, and some demos use the GPU through WebGL or render in a worker with OffscreenCanvas. The app can be installed (PWA) and keeps working offline after the first visit.
help.sourceBody: This app is open source. Bug reports and suggestions are welcome on GitHub.
